text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can accept that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Is it that you're incredibly sensitive, or is it that you have an exceptionally strong sense of justice?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer? No, it's nothing really.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just a moment ago, there were some Umamusume talking about me. They were saying—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: They were being so cruel! They called Tachyon a dangerous person who's always making strange drugs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're her trainer, so you won't let that slide, right?
choice_data_list: I'm certainly not a fan of badmouthing people behind their back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right! We need to call attention to—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Stop it! This is a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I don't care. This matter is completely unrelated to my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Gaining the approval of others isn't my priority.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: How can you say that?! They're all getting the wrong idea about you. It's so sad!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, now, no need to get all worked up over it. How about some tea to calm you down?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Phew. Thanks for the tea.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It made my tongue tingle a bit and had a mysterious flavor, but it was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. That's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… I still can't accept what happened earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Saying bad things about someone who's earnestly pursuing their dreams… it's just not right!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… You're really serious about this. What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let your research results prove them wrong.
Show them what makes you amazing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I couldn't care less if they reconsider their opinion, but the approach in itself isn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah… That's true. Actually proving yourself is a sure bet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You know… I'm sorry. I sort of stepped outside my bounds there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You did absolutely nothing wrong! Come on, keep your head up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For some reason, seeing you feeling down makes me restless.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Thanks for everything, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well… sorry for staying so long. Thanks for the tea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet seems satisfied as she leaves, however…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's odd… I laced her tea with a concoction designed to transmit signals from her nerves to her hair, triggering movement based on her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Her hair was supposed to stand on end in reaction to her anger, yet…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, there was basically no change at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was hoping I'd be a step further towards actualizing body modification, but it seems to be another failure! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but think, perhaps she is in fact a dangerous person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Agnes Tachyon learned something from the interaction with Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's a bold thing to say… Are you suggesting I showcase the results of my research?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's it! Do you have any recent successful experiments to show off?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Um… the one on turns, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Turns?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have these glasses that lead you on a less strenuous path when navigating a turn on a track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wow! That sounds amazing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: They might not be allowed in an actual race, but you could use them during training to better adapt to the track!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, perhaps, but there's still room for improvement…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let's do it! Why waste any time? We should show them right now!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: O-okay, okay. …You really don't let up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pressed by Daiwa Scarlet, Agnes Tachyon works through the night to complete the glasses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with their use, she successfully masters the art of running through turns.
